title.rendered: Sip & Spell Fundraiser for Sherwood Education Foundation (SEF)

content.rendered:
Tickets are now available for the Feb 8th Sip and Spell Dinner, sponsored by the Sherwood Education Foundation. It will be held at the Sherwood Center for the Performing Arts from 6-9:30pm. This fundraising event will feature a silent auction, dinner and local adult celebrity spelling bee featuring teachers and community members. A fun event for the community to get together and support our schools.

For ticket info click http://www.sherwoodeducationfoundation.org/tickets/
